content: Next, we validate our findings on the WMT'18 English-Turkish task for which the bitext is truly limited (208K sentence-pairs). We use the language model vocab for the the English side of the bitext and a BPE vocabulary learned on the Turkish side. Table TABREF15 shows that ELMo embeddings for the encoder improve English-Turkish translation.
